notes.title: 2025.08.21 Update Log
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
Fixed the issue of the login screen being stuck on loading and unable to proceed (added additional log recording for troubleshooting).
Feature Improvements:
Added support for transparent materials in PMX format models.

notes.title: 2025.07.17 Update Log
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
Fixed the issue of camera clipping through when lying down.
Feature Improvements:
Added support for PMX format models.

Added image upload and cropping functionality.

Improved the responsiveness and feel of model rotation in the creation interface.

notes.title: 2025.06.16 Update Log
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where the Agent sometimes does not appear when entering a scene.

Fixed an issue where certain buttons may not display correctly in ultra-wide screen mode.

notes.title: 2025.05.29 Update Log
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue where Zhi Ling's mouth sometimes remained in an odd pose after speaking.

Feature Improvements:
Upgraded the AI model, resulting in more human-like and natural dialogue performance.

notes.title: 2025.04.23 Update Log
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:
· Resolved issues that could cause the program to crash when entering the world, starting conversations, or using voice input.
· Fixed occasional issues with excessively long delays during conversations.
· Addressed problems with texture errors when cloning certain AI characters.

Feature Improvements:
· Optimized the package size.
· Enhanced the model upload experience to support larger models.

notes.title: 2025.04.02 Update Log (New Gameplay Launch)
notes.notes:
New Features:
· Added a gameplay generator along with two short script experiences, preparing for future functionality that will allow users to create their own gameplay.

Bug Fixes:
· Fixed an issue where square content refresh occasionally returned empty.
· Fixed a problem where some models experienced clipping issues during character customization.
· Resolved an issue where the camera could not rotate during certain scene interactions.

Feature Improvements:
· Added basic settings in the options menu, including resolution adjustment, fullscreen/windowed mode switching, and volume control.
· Enabled mouse drag-and-rotate functionality during character customization, allowing for better inspection of customization results.
· Enhanced the animations of the AI companion, making them more lively.
· Improved the efficiency of switching AI companions and added hotkeys for quicker access.
· Optimized the BGM playback logic, making it less monotonous.
· Refined the UI design of the square page, making it more visually appealing.

notes.title: 2025.03.13 Update Log
notes.notes:
BUG Fixes:

Fixed an issue where the AI Agent occasionally acted like an idiot, reducing intimacy with you even when you were seeking comfort.
Fixed an issue where the AI Agent occasionally behaved like someone mentally challenged, going west when you clearly told her to go east.
Fixed the frequent failure of directly rewinding screen recordings by pressing Z, and self-imposed a penalty of three cups due to insufficient testing.
Fixed an issue where strange texts occasionally appeared above the AI Agent’s head, hiding the truth that she was "executing commands".
Fixed the shattered heart of our product manager who read some comments.
Revised some internal perspectives; we are considering allowing users to experience more without recharging (maybe in the next version update).


Function Optimizations:

Enriched the emotional expressions of the AI Agent, enabling her to express emotions more naturally.
Improved the efficiency of warming up your relationship with the AI Agent. Besides, silent companionship will also slowly increase intimacy.
Optimized some experiences so that users can quickly experience behaviors after the relationship has warmed up.
Further optimized the AI dialogue model to make it more human-like.
Optimized the AI voice synthesis model, significantly improving the AI Agent's English proficiency.
Visually optimized the face customization interface to prevent it from triggering photosensitive epilepsy.
Optimized the face customization function; it now aligns the camera with the AI Agent’s face whenever you adjust any parameters.
Optimized the display of the main interface clock to prevent it from being mistaken for a countdown timer in the virtual world.
Optimized the scene visuals based on subjective feelings. If you find it ugly, please leave a comment or send an email, and we will optimize it as soon as possible.

notes.title: 2025.02.13 update log
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:


 Unstable display of self-talk text above the AI avatar’s head.
 Unable to access another user's profile page via the followers/following page.
 Occasional failure when gifting items.
 Unable to record audio by pressing "R" when creating an AI clone voice.
 Some explanatory texts appearing off-screen in non-1080P resolutions.
 Camera tilt not resetting after chatting under specific conditions.
 No prompt displayed when a chat session unexpectedly disconnects.
 occasional perspective issues when a user or AI avatar sits on a computer chair.
 Incorrect display of user avatars in the Moments and Likes sections of the personal profile page.


Functional Improvements:


 Added a button to return to the title page in the more options menu.
 Added "Enter World" and "Exit Game" buttons on the title page.
 Enabled automatic full-screen mode upon launching the game.
 Enhanced the AI model's response time for conversations and commands.
